description: IRVE statique (organisation Mobilize Power Solutions) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mobilize Power Solutions. IRVE charging points operated by Mobilize Power Solutions This dataset meets the specifications of the "static EVIR" schema available on schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Mobilize Power Solutions. The portal shows the English title as "Static IRVE (Mobilize Power Solutions Organization)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mobilize Power Solutions. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
